title: 50 Shades of Graytall
description: 50 Shades of Graytall is an 18-level megawad built around severe architectural design constraints. Each map limits visible wall textures to DOORTRAK, FIREBLU1, and GRAYTALL, combined with F_SKY1 and a single flat of the author's choice. The project aims to produce interesting gameplay and aesthetically pleasing architecture despite using these notoriously hideous textures.
